pages.title: Pelorovis
pages.text: The Pelorovis ($(o)Pelorovis oldowayensis$()) is an extinct bovine that lived in East Africa during the Early Pleistocene, best known from fossils at Olduvai Gorge in Tanzania.$(br2)It was one of the largest bovines that ever lived, with large males possibly reaching two tonnes.$(br2)Its horn cores alone were about a metre long, each curving away from the head in a half circle. Its name means monstrous sheep, after the shape of these horns.
